case_number: 2024 INSC 404; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. OF 2024 (@ SPECIAL LEAVE PETITION (CRIMINAL) NO. OF 2024) (@ DIARY NO.27308 OF 2023)

parties.respondent: Mrityunjay Kumar Singh @ Mrityunjay @ Sonu Singh

summary: Bail appeal arising from terrorist attack on police; prosecution alleged respondent provided financial/logistical support to CPI-Maoist; recovered unaccounted cash (Rs.2.64 crores); High Court granted bail conditionally; Supreme Court examined prima facie evidence standard under UAPA; no mention of respondent in FIR/witness statements; bail conditions not violated for 1+ years; standard: reasonable grounds for prima facie truth under special enactments; appeal dismissed; bail maintained.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; bail order upheld; respondent to remain on bail as per High Court conditions.
